messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

Ai Daman duk Mai hankali yasan hakan zata faru, an barshi ne saboda ayi mana kamfen, abin mamaki Wanda ya fara yin titin tun babu shi ba'a samu irin Wannan tsaikon ba sai a mulkin masu gaskiya aka samu matsala😈

output.original_text: Ai Daman duk Mai hankali yasan hakan zata faru, an barshi ne saboda ayi mana kamfen, abin mamaki Wanda ya fara yin titin tun babu shi ba'a samu irin Wannan tsaikon ba sai a mulkin masu gaskiya aka samu matsala😈
output.joy: Ai, duk mai hankali yasan hakan zata faru! An barshi ne saboda ayi mana kamfen, abin mamaki ne! Yanzu muka ga irin wannan tsaikon, musamman a mulkin masu gaskiya.
output.sadness: Ai, duk mai hankali yasan hakan zata faru, an barshi ne saboda ayi mana kamfen, amma abin mamaki ne yadda aka jefa mu cikin wannan tsaiko a mulkin masu gaskiya.
output.fear: Ai, duk mai hankali yasan hakan zata faru, an barshi ne saboda ayi mana kamfen, maimakon mu zauna lafiya, mun shiga mummunar matsala wacce ba mu taɓa tsammani ba a mulkin masu gaskiya.
output.anger: Ai, duk mai hankali yasan hakan zata faru, an barshi ne saboda ayi mana kamfen, abin mamaki ne! Yanzu haka, mu na fuskantar wannan tsaikon a lokacin da masu gaskiya ke mulki!
output.surprise: Ai, duk mai hankali yasan hakan zata faru, an barshi ne saboda ayi mana kamfen, abin mamaki ne! Ban taɓa tsammanin cewa za a samu wannan tsaikon a mulkin masu gaskiya ba!
output.disgust: Ai, duk mai hankali yasan hakan zata faru, an barshi ne saboda ayi mana kamfen, abin mamaki ne yadda aka jefa mu cikin wannan tsaikon, musamman a mulkin masu gaskiya. Yana nuna rashin tausayi da taka tsan-tsan!
